title: Trip-Type Credit Points for Airport and Reserved Trips (Wayfare Pass)
content:
# Trip-type credit points

*Wayfare Pass (rider membership): Pass ride credit on airport and reserved trips.*

**Definition.** The trip-type points are 1 percentage point for a trip that picked up or dropped off at an airport, 0.5 percentage point for a reserved trip that touched no airport, and nothing for any other trip. They are added to the plan's Pass ride credit rate for that trip.

**Records.** The trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares): its airport leg (pickup, drop-off or none) and its booking mode (on demand, or reserved through Wayfare Reserve).

| Airport leg | Booking mode | Points |
|---|---|---|
| pickup or drop-off | on demand | 1 |
| pickup or drop-off | reserved | 1 |
| none | reserved | 0.5 |
| none | on demand | nothing |

A reserved airport trip takes the airport point, 1, not 1.5: the 0.5 applies only to a reserved trip with no airport leg.

**Examples (hypothetical).** On Wayfare Pass Annual (credit rate 6 percent) with an eligible fare of 50.00: an on-demand airport drop-off takes 7 percent, 3.50; a reserved trip across town takes 6.5 percent, 3.25; an on-demand trip across town stays at 6 percent, 3.00.
